frozenDesign.objectTable: The 142-row version-of-record NGC 3447 MRT pinned in RC65
frozenDesign.projection: Tangent-plane arcseconds about RA 163.36 deg, Dec 16.78 deg; x=(RA-RA0)cos(Dec0)3600, y=(Dec-Dec0)3600
frozenDesign.translationObjective: Maximize development matches within 0.10 arcsec, then minimize matched squared residual, L1 shift, x shift, and y shift in that order

archiveInventoryGate.rule: Observation and product identities must be read from pinned official API responses; filenames are not inferred from paper prose.

semanticGate.pass: All 154 reported correction targets map to author IDs and the 154-to-144-to-142 transitions execute without coordinate inference.
semanticGate.claimBoundary: Generic MAST segmentation labels, coordinates, and aperture magnitudes do not satisfy the author-lineage gate.

crossmatchGate.purpose: Measure archive-catalog recoverability, not reproduce the paper's custom photometry or infer a crowding correction.
crossmatchGate.dualBandRule: A validation object is recovered only when each frozen translated coordinate has a nearest F090W and F150W catalog source within the radius.
crossmatchGate.componentContrast: Compare tidal and spiral validation recovery with an exact Fisher test; preserve the other component separately.
crossmatchGate.breaksWhen: Coordinate uncertainties exceed the radius, nearest-neighbour ambiguity dominates, the catalog segmentation changes, or component membership proxies different source populations.

nextExperiment.name: Position-forced injection crossover
nextExperiment.minimumTest: Freeze the author-coordinate transform on the development split, force PSF photometry at every validation coordinate irrespective of catalog detection, and inject artificial stars matched in magnitude and colour across local-background strata.
nextExperiment.success: Two independent reductions reproduce inclusion probabilities and magnitude-bias curves within preregistered tolerances, and inverse-probability sensitivity changes the component contrast by less than 0.01 mag.
nextExperiment.reject: Recovery depends on unmodelled component-specific structure, injected and real residuals disagree, or the two reductions disagree beyond the uncertainty budget.
nextExperiment.stop: Do not use the first-pass catalogs to estimate a Cepheid distance or global H0; stop causal interpretation until custom-PSF and author-lineage receipts are available.

independentImplementationGate.rule: Both implementations independently parse the pinned text catalogs and agree on shifts, validation counts, control counts, component tables, residual summaries, and exact-test probabilities.
